test_title: PYST 34: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Gold is __much__ costly than any other metal.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. more.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is comparing gold with other metals, which requires the use of a comparative degree of the adjective.
